board: "ICM-42688 6-Axis IMU Accelerometer Gyroscope, I2C SPI Interface" blue 8-pin module (Amazon B0F3JWY1XF, QUAINTBYTE)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator, PCB). The driver follows the TDK datasheet: WHO_AM_I 0x47, soft reset, PWR_MGMT0 0x0F, big-endian data from 0x1D, ±4 g and ±500 dps, T = raw/132.48 + 25. SDO is tied to GND (0x68) and CS to 3V3 as the datasheet requires for I2C, and 4.7 kΩ pull-ups are added because the board's pull-ups are behind an open solder jumper.
breakoutPinoutSource: Amazon B0F3JWY1XF product photos (https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/71tIMEytkaL._SL1500_.jpg, back 71o-qaW7RfL / 71QXY6N4wyL): rows SDO, SDA/SDI, SCL, CS and INT, FSY, GND, 3V3; I2C pull-up solder jumper on the back
